name: Cognex Corporation
moat_justification: Market leader with proven historical pricing power, but gross margin has eroded ~9pp since 2017 and ROIC ran 7-8% through the 2023-25 trough; strong niche franchise, contested and cyclical — 5/10.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 1.11 vs 3-yr median 0.47 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.1x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Debt-free machine-vision leader, moat 5/10, in a genuine recovery — but at $53.99 the weighted IRR is 6.4% (IV@15% $15.40); it clears 15% only below ~$15.40.
moat_for: Global leader in industrial machine vision — installed base, application know-how, brand
Historically premium gross margins (72-76% through 2022) evidencing pricing power
Asset-light: FY2025 capex $8.7M on $994M revenue; no debt
OneVision AI platform and software attach extending the franchise
moat_against: Gross margin eroded from 75.6% (2017) to 66.9% (2025) — measured pricing/mix pressure
ROIC proxy fell from 22.2% (2021) to 7-8% in the 2023-25 trough
Keyence and low-cost Asian rivals (e.g. Hikrobot) contest the same budgets
Cyclical factory/logistics capex end markets — OE/share fell to $0.20 in 2023
Demand concentration in consumer-electronics and logistics capex cycles
